how: tools/student_recall.py draw: seeded stratified sample by recorded student rows (0 / 1-2 / 3+); the checker fills `verdict`, `page` and `listed`

sample.notes: REVIEW 1125: the only readable page is his YALE group page (header 'Yale University'; students Wu, Lindsay, Ugur, Thakur and alumni Sriram, Gupta, Vesely, Yan, Cox). No line on it names Princeton or any other school beside a student, so no outside_school proof is possible, and nothing proves any of them was a Princeton student; counting them would charge Yale students against Princeton recall. Reclassified unverifiable (no Princeton member list; the Princeton profile lists none). Filler's earlier note: His own homepage (cs.yale.edu/homes/abhishek, found as the first candidate) loads and has a Research Group list: current PhD students, one undergraduate, dated PhD alumni ('23..'18); postdocs (Desai, Pothukuchi) and Binh Pham '15 (before window) not listed. This is his Yale group; Princeton scope not judged here, all names are as printed. Princeton profile lists no students.

Only PI-owned candidate (www-ee.stanford.edu/~andrea, Stanford WSL) is blocked by robots/earlier refusal; the Princeton ECE profile Wayback copies list no members; no Princeton group member page found.

Lab site prism.robotics.princeton.edu/contact served a bot challenge (status 999, stopped). Wayback home (2026-03-12) captured: names only 'Mingtong, Sam, Yixun' by first name in a news line and links Members -> /members, which Wayback does not hold. The listed candidate saferobotics.princeton.edu/people is Fisac's lab, not Shah's (it only mentions one Shah student, Sam, in his bio). No listable names.

REVIEW 1125: the reason 'bot_challenge' was not true for his own pages: http://www.princeton.edu:80/~verdu/ and /publications.html are in the capture store with status 200 and are a faculty home page (last update 2011) and a publication list, with no student or member names. Reason corrected to no_member_list_page. Filler's earlier note: www.princeton.edu/~verdu host is blocked in the capture store after an earlier challenge on that host; other candidates are DataSpace OAI listings, not member pages; not read.
Candidates are only DataSpace OAI thesis listings (not member pages); no PI-owned member-list link found; www.princeton.edu host is blocked after a challenge, so no page under it was fetched.

snehagoenka.com (Google Sites: Home, Awards, News, Talks, Teaching, Apply) captured with its News page: no members/people page, no student names; the second candidate is a Wayback ECE profile of another person.
vdean.github.io captured: no members/students section; news names a single thesis student (Anha Khan) in a sentence only, not a roster.

Candidate home page (cs.princeton.edu/~af) lists no students; its research link goes to the PIXL site, whose people page (pixl.engineering.princeton.edu/people, captured) lists faculty only (core+affiliated), no students. No member page for his Graphics Lab was reachable from his official pages.
Google Sites home page captured: publications and course pages only, no students/members section; cs.princeton.edu/people/grad candidate is the department list, not his.
Emeritus professor; her page lists PhD dissertations 1984-2007 (Shao 2007, Chen 2005 ...), all before the 2016 window, and no current students. Nothing in the window is listed.

REVIEW 1125: the HCI people page is a shared roster of four HCI faculty with no per-student adviser; the nine other graduate names (Dae Kim, Kiyosu Maeda, Inhwa Song, Lauren Wang, Cyrus Vachha, Ching-Yi Tsai, Slater Fisch, Michelle Le, Jules Mpano) are attributed to him only by that same page in students.json, so they are removed from `listed` (not attributable to him). Kept: Yuhan Liu and Romina Mahinpei, whose advisers 'Andres Monroy-Hernandez' are named on the department grad lists (cs.princeton.edu/people/grad). Readable on two names, incomplete for his group. Filler's earlier note: Princeton HCI group page (he is director); its Graduate Students section is a current roster of the whole HCI group, advisers are not attributed per student (Abtahi, Horta Ribeiro, Vertesi etc. are co-listed faculty), so some names may belong to other faculty. Dae Kim and Kiyosu Maeda are marked on leave. Postdocs and undated Alumni (Desta, Kim, Panigrahi, Zhang, Zhou, Oshinowo, Rao) excluded. His personal page andresmh.com has only a Mentoring list of interns.

REVIEW 1125: the filler's js_not_renderable was true only for the live page and the 2026-10 copy; the audit's own candidate Wayback copies of /people/ (2024-11-08 and 2020-02-05, both static) were not tried. Captured both with the tool. 2024: Postdoctoral Scholars and Graduate Students (Ph.D. students) and Undergraduate students, current at that date; postdocs (Badithela, Shorinwa) excluded; Alumni undated (Pacelli, Farid, Booker, Veer, Dixit) excluded there. 2020: Graduate students (Pacelli, Farid, Booker current at that date) and Undergraduate students; Veer postdoc excluded. Both snapshots are older than 2025-26, so recent entrants are unseen.

Wayback copy (2026-09-07) of hanin.princeton.edu; the Research Group paragraph names six current PhD students (Shigida and Bhandarkar co-advised) and two postdocs (excluded); 'First Placement of Former Members' lists undated former members (postdocs and later), excluded.

Same capture (sha unchanged) as the 2026-11-12 record; current PhD students, undergraduates and dated alumni as listed; postdocs excluded. REVIEW 1125: removed five non-students that had been listed: postdocs Ryan Feathers, Jeffrey Gu and Ramya Rangan, collaborator Axel Levy (Stanford PhD), visiting research software engineer Vineet Bansal; the 20 students remain (M.Fin and MSE students kept).

Live scholar.princeton.edu is a bot challenge (status 999, stopped); the page used is the Wayback copy of the Lab Members page from 2022-10-03, so 'current' means current in Oct 2022 and is stale for 2025-26. Former Grad Students are undated (excluded); postdocs and staff excluded; Julia Edgar, Morgan Sly, Chase Palisch, Jennifer Wang, Irene Zhang undated.

Princeton scholar profile served a bot challenge (stopped); his group site kevrekidis.wse.jhu.edu (JHU, since 2017) is disallowed by robots; the other candidates are DataSpace OAI listings. No member page read.

Live host is a bot challenge (stopped); Wayback copies: People (2024-07-07, Graduate Students = nine current at that date) and Alumni (2024-09-12, Ph.D. years). Alumni before 2016 are outside the window and not listed. Snapshot is 2024, so 2025-26 entrants are unseen.

pettagroup.princeton.edu (found via an arXiv citation, no Princeton page links a roster) is blocked for the capture tool (robots disallow/unreadable or host blocked); search shows he moved to UCLA 2022 and no official roster; other candidates are DataSpace OAI listings.

Homepage has dated alumni lists (PhD, Masters, Post-doc) and no current-students section; dated in-window names listed (Mengying Pan MSE 2020 is the same person as the 2025 PhD). Pre-2016 alumni and postdocs excluded. Current students are not listed on this page.

Same capture (sha unchanged) as the 2026-11-12 record: single undated 'Graduate Students' roster of a new assistant professor, counted as the current roster (judgment call, heading is not literally 'Current').

Live vision.princeton.edu is disallowed by robots; the only readable copy is the Wayback snapshot of 2017-01-02 (Princeton Vision & Robotics Group), whose PhD/Master/Undergrad sections are the current roster as of that date (9 years old; Sachin Ravi is with Kai Li). Alumni there are undated (excluded).
jonathanmayer.org captured with its Advising page: advising for prospective students only, no student roster, no names.

Live www.princeton.edu host is blocked after an earlier challenge; Wayback copy (2025-11-21) of the group Members page: Current Members graduate students listed; postdocs excluded; dated Graduate Alumni and visiting graduate students (Princeton '19, '18) listed.

REVIEW 1125: the filler's 2019-11-15 snapshot is headed 'Network Operations and Internet Security @ UChicago' (UChicago-era, no Princeton evidence on it), so its names are not shown to be Princeton students and it is dropped. The audit's own candidate snapshot of 2016-11-21 is headed '@ Princeton' and is the Princeton group page: captured with the tool; Ph.D. Students and M.S. Students sections are current at that date (in the window); postdoc Ensafi and research scientist excluded; dated alumni on it are 2007-2015, before the window. Several of its PhD students (e.g. Narain, Mundada) are not recorded at Princeton, so this page may legitimately show misses. Snapshot is 2016, so later entrants are unseen.
www.princeton.edu host is blocked in the capture store after an earlier challenge; the only readable copy, Wayback 2018-06-15 of ~samory, has research/papers pages and no member list.

Live host is a bot challenge (stopped); Wayback copy (2025-08-05) of Members: Graduate Students and Postdocs (postdoc Subhajit Karmakar excluded) plus current Undergraduate Students; Alumni undated (excluded).
Current Lab Members: five PhD students; postdocs, research staff and Lewis-Sigler Scholars excluded; Alumni undated (Dolsten, Kosfeld, Walker, Chakarov excluded).
Students section on the home page: current (Wang co-advised with Wyatt Lloyd) and graduated with PhD years.

Same capture as the 2026-11-12 record. The page has a Current Students section but no date; the live home page (2026) no longer links it (orphan, likely stale: Gopi and Oliveira finished years ago). Counted only under the strict current-section rule.

Lab roster on the home page (undated, treated as current like other personal-page rosters). Excluded: Gabe Sarch (PLI postdoc) and Zhuorui Ye (incoming PhD, not yet enrolled). Haozhe Chen is listed 'w/ Karthik Narasimhan'.

signoff.note: Fresh reviewer (not drawer or filler) read all 30 entries against the stored captures. Corrected: Bhattacharjee (Yale group page, no Princeton proof) to unverifiable; Monroy-Hernandez (shared HCI roster) kept only the two names attributed to him on dept pages; Majumdar made readable from two static Wayback copies of his people page that the filler had not tried; Zhong lost five postdoc/staff/collaborator names; Feamster moved from the UChicago-era 2019 snapshot to the Princeton-labelled 2016 snapshot; Verdu reason corrected to no_member_list_page. Xiao (Jan 2017 Princeton Vision group snapshot, current at that date), Dvir (current-section rule; stale and orphan, noted), Cristea, Sturm, Rexford, Hanin, Ding, Chen, Ghasempour, Pritykin, Kincaid, Liu and the other unverifiable reasons checked with no change. Sample, seed and binds untouched.
